granger_causality.methodology: Grouped per commodity-market time series (lags 1-7 days) with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction
granger_causality.note: Measures statistical Granger-predictive association, not real-world physical causal proof.

purged_walk_forward_cv.evaluation_data_scope: 2019-2024 Train and Validation Data Only (2025 Test Set strictly isolated)

arima_baseline.protocol: ARIMA(1,1,1) one-step sequential update with refit=False

Model_C_No_Weather.description: Removed 12 NASA weather, NDVI, and stress features

Model_D_No_Arrivals.description: Removed 5 arrival volume and ratio features

Model_E_No_Weather_No_Arrivals.description: Removed all 17 exogenous weather and arrival features

Model_F_No_Spatial.description: Removed 3 Haversine distance and spatial price gradient features

Model_G_No_Festivals.description: Removed 3 festival demand anticipation and hangover features

isolation_forest.operational_framing: Unsupervised supply shock anomaly detector designed to flag extreme volume/price divergence days for market advisory triage.
isolation_forest.methodological_disclosure: Evaluated against operational heuristic proxy rules (arrival_ratio > 1.5 or price_velocity < -50 Rs/qtl/day), not verified historical ground-truth events. High specificity demonstrates strong normal-day retention.

covid_period_consistency_analysis.study_type: In-sample training-period temporal consistency analysis during the COVID-19 period (2020-2021 shock vs 2022-2024 normal)

ljung_box_residual_test.method: Per commodity-market series; residuals sorted by date

bootstrap_confidence_intervals_95.method: Panel-Aware Circular Block Bootstrap (7-Day Within-Series Blocks)
